application_compatibility.note: Tests were run against a temporary copy of the candidate; the original candidate was not modified.

findings.title: Production server was not accessed
findings.evidence: Workspace is Windows; no systemctl/nginx; no production SSH/session; no verified production DATABASE_URL. No stop, copy, restore, or restart was performed.
findings.action: Provide approved server access or perform the replacement from the Linux server after review.

findings.title: SQLite candidate vs PostgreSQL service configuration
findings.evidence: Candidate is SQLite. gvpowers.service points to /opt/gv_powers_erp and Wants=postgresql.service; .env.example uses postgresql://. Candidate audit log says the backup was created at /home/kaml/erp-new/backups/database/.
findings.action: Confirm the actual production unit and DATABASE_URL. Do not install the SQLite file over PostgreSQL or into an unverified path.

findings.title: Default admin password is still in use
findings.evidence: The candidate admin password hash matches the application fallback ADMIN_PASSWORD. The same is true for the local live database. Password was not changed.
findings.action: Rotate the admin password after explicit owner approval; do not reset silently.

findings.title: Paid invoices have no payment rows
findings.evidence: Candidate invoices total 1,020,055.00 and amount_paid totals 1,020,055.00, but payments has 0 rows. Customer ledger closing totals 1,020,055.00 while invoice balance_due totals 0.00.
findings.action: Do not silently backfill. Owner must approve either a payment-record correction or acceptance of the reporting mismatch; fix the invoice-creation path that writes amount_paid without a Payment row.

findings.title: Candidate is not a newer copy of the local live database
findings.evidence: Candidate has 2 invoices, 2 customers, 8 products, 19 stock movements, 43 audit logs. Local live has 0 invoices, 1 customer, 2 products, 0 stock movements, 7 audit logs. Local live has activity at 2026-10-31 03:23 UTC; candidate snapshot time is 03:11:22 UTC.
findings.action: Do not overwrite either database based on timestamps alone. Verify the production current DB and row deltas.

findings.title: Remote archive sync is not evidenced
findings.evidence: Candidate backup_events=0 and settings=0. Only a local backup_created audit log exists. No BACKUP_API_KEY can be confirmed because .env is absent from the workspace and production is inaccessible.
findings.action: Verify BACKUP_API_URL, BACKUP_API_KEY, and archive delivery on the production host before relying on the backup.

findings.title: Invoice 2 has a 0.02 line-total rounding variance
findings.evidence: INV-30102026-001 line totals sum 361,055.22; taxable+CGST+SGST is 361,055.24; stored grand total is 361,055.00 after -0.24 round-off.
findings.action: Record as a known rounding variance; do not modify historical invoice data without approval.

findings.title: Customer GSTIN fails the application checksum validator
findings.evidence: Candidate customer 1 GSTIN 33AELFS8595R1ZR returns False from the app's validate_gstIN().
findings.action: Verify with the customer/GST portal; do not alter the invoice or customer master automatically.

findings.title: All product purchase prices are zero
findings.evidence: All 8 candidate products have purchase_price=0.00; profit and stock-value reports will be misleading.
findings.action: Owner to provide purchase costs if profit/valuation reporting is required; do not invent costs.

findings.title: No .env in local workspace; insecure fallbacks apply locally
findings.evidence: Only .env.example exists. The app falls back to change-me-in-production for SECRET_KEY and the default admin credentials when variables are absent. Production environment is not accessible.
findings.action: Verify the production .env on the server; rotate SECRET_KEY/passwords through an approved change window.

findings.title: Admin email is not a valid email address
findings.action: Correct after approval; this may affect email-based workflows.

findings.title: Low-stock alert metadata is incomplete
findings.evidence: 8 of 8 candidate products are at or below min_stock; only 3 have low_stock_alert_active=1 and matching notifications. Five low-stock products have no alert metadata.
findings.action: Let the app run its normal low-stock check after restore, or review alert policy; do not silently fabricate notifications.

findings.title: Core integrity checks passed
findings.evidence: Candidate integrity_check=ok, quick_check=ok, foreign_key_check=[], no orphan rows, no duplicate business keys, all stock movement sums match stock_quantity.

findings.title: Candidate schema matches the app models
findings.evidence: All 19 table definitions and indexes match the SQLAlchemy model schema. App startup on a temporary copy changed neither schema nor row counts; invoice template rendered; /invoices, /products, /customers, /reports, /settings, /backup returned HTTP 200 for an authenticated admin session.
findings.action: Schema compatibility is acceptable; deployment is still blocked by freshness/engine/access issues.

reasons: SQLite candidate vs PostgreSQL service configuration
Default admin password is still in use
Paid invoices have no payment rows
replacement.next_gate: Confirm production DATABASE_URL, unit path, and server access; snapshot current production DB; compare row deltas; obtain owner approval for credential rotation and payment-ledger inconsistency.
